candidates.name: Tony Wied
candidates.now: U.S. Representative, Wisconsin's 8th District (incumbent)
candidates.background: Incumbent Republican first elected in a 2024 special election, running unopposed in his primary and seeking a full term on spending cuts, border security and energy independence.

cost.label: Campaign issue pillar 'Curbing Out of Control Spending' (campaign issues page)

immigration.label: Voted yes on the Laken Riley Act (roll call 23, Jan 22, 2025); backs securing 'our southern border and stop the rampant crime, influx of illegal drugs and dangerous human trafficking' (campaign issues page)

taxes.label: Voted yes on H.R. 1, the 2025 tax law (roll call 190, Jul 3, 2025)

climate.label: Says 'American energy independence is vital to ensuring our domestic and global security' and pledges to 'reduce government regulations to unleash America's energy potential' (campaign issues page)

democracy.label: Voted yes on the SAVE Act, H.R. 22, requiring documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote (roll call 102, Apr 10, 2025)

health.label: Voted aye on H.R.1, the 2025 reconciliation law that cut federal Medicaid spending roughly $911B over 10 years via nationwide work requirements (clerk.house.gov roll 190, Jul 3, 2025)

safety.label: Voted yes on H.R.27/S.331, the HALT Fentanyl Act permanently classifying fentanyl analogues as Schedule I with mandatory minimums (clerk.house.gov roll 33, Feb 6, 2025)

repro.label: Voted yes on H.R.21, the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act (clerk.house.gov roll 27, Jan 23, 2025)
